$description: Signing keys whose LibKa manifests a verifier should trust. Only public fingerprints live here (first 16 hex of the SHA-256 of the DER public key); private keys stay in .libka/signing-key.pem or the LIBKA_SIGNING_KEY secret and are never committed. Add a key by running libka build once and copying the fingerprint from libka verify. A replaced key gets "retired" (the date it stopped signing; its manifests stay trusted); a compromised key gets "revoked" (its manifests are no longer trusted). See docs/admin/signing-keys.md.
